## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible change and link any related issue. Include a concrete before/after example when useful.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. For DSP changes, include the relevant regression and decoded-export measurements; for UI changes, include actual captures at default and compact sizes. Identify any checks you could not run.

## Rights and compatibility

Mention new dependencies, separately licensed assets or behavior changes. Only include code, images and audio you have permission to redistribute; retain required notices.
